summary: Iteration 4 tested both backend and frontend. Backend: new pytest suite test_amodo_iter4_planner.py, 11 of 12 passing. Covered: treatment parse via LLM (full plan / missing data asks questions / short text 422), plan commit (1 treatment + N events with treatment_id/series_id, next_session), series edit one/following/all (date shift + history), agenda (120-day limit, med '08:00, 20:00' expands per day, unique keys, caregiver sees only shared items), doses (realizado/omitido/validation/403 for caregiver on unshared med), pending, reminders (discreet generic text, cats/leads honoured, enabled=false -> empty, unique keys), needs/recommendations/explain/feedback/knowledge (nausea excludes 'Antojos y preferencias'), media (p1.jpg public, other paths 404). Regression suites iter1+iter2 all pass (36/36). The one failure: GET /api/pending?today=xx returns 500. Frontend (390/360): agenda Mes/Semana/Día/Lista with dots, day list, add sheet (7 options), dose sheet -> Realizado; /pending 5 filters + Realizado/Omitido/Deshacer; treatment assistant parse -> edit interval/count/start regenerates -> remove session -> confirm saves to DB and appears in Agenda; series edit -> series-scope-sheet with 3 options -> 'Esta y las siguientes' updates both events + history; 'Otro' + custom_name create/edit works; notification settings persist (cats, leads, custom 90 min, quiet, discreet) and web limitation text shown; Mis kits needs prompt + chips + save, compact reco cards, why-sheet with LLM text; catalog search + category chips + AI images + 'precio de ejemplo'; Inter everywhere and logo in PJS-800; no horizontal page overflow at 360/390; caregiver agenda sees only shared items. MAIN BUG: hard load / deep link (and native cold start) fires queries before the auth token is restored -> 401 'No pudimos cargar esto' on Agenda/Pendientes, and /record-form crashes ('Cannot read properties of null (reading id)'). Deprecated packages: no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch, but 'expo-router/unstable-native-tabs' raises a deprecation warning.

minor.issue: An invalid 'today' value (e.g. 'xx') gives 500 (ValueError in strptime, planner.py:232). Validate with _date_or_empty and return 422.
History 'before' snapshot also stores unchanged fields (title/type/location/date). Noisy history; store only the fields that changed.
Every 60s it scans all users and runs the full agenda queries for each one. Fine for an MVP, but O(users) DB load per minute.

ui_bugs.issue: Screens render and useApi queries fire while auth ready=false, before the token is loaded from storage. Hard load of /agenda or /pending shows the error state ('No pudimos cargar esto / Inicia sesión para continuar', console 401 on /api/pending and /api/agenda) until the user taps Reintentar. This also affects native cold start and opening the app from a notification (reminder link /(tabs)/agenda). Fix: render a loader / return null until ready, or gate useApi with enabled: ready && hasToken.

/record-form?kind=treatments opened directly (deep link/refresh) crashes the whole app with ErrorBoundary 'Cannot read properties of null (reading id)'. Cause: user!.id at app/record-form.tsx:47 while user is still null. Same root cause as above; also guard user.

The per-session time input (ta-session-time-i) collapses to about 18px wide on web, so the time cannot be seen or edited. style {flex: 0, width: 72} combined with styles.mini {flex:1, minWidth:0} (app/treatment-assistant.tsx:126,148). Use flexGrow:0, flexShrink:0, width:72.
After removing a session (ta-session-remove-i), the 'Sesiones' field still shows the old count (3 while 2 sessions are listed).

'Me interesa', 'No me interesa' and 'Ya lo tengo' render with no spacing ('Me interesaNo me interesaYa lo tengo') on a 264px card. They are also tiny caption touch targets (<44px). src/components/reco-card.tsx:32-36 (styles.links).

Opening the treatment created by the assistant (name 'TEST_Radio', treatment_type 'Radioterapia') in record-form shows 'Otro' + custom name, because only the name is checked (record-form.tsx:38). On save, body.treatment_type = 'Otro' (line 68). This silently loses the real type, which is used by the knowledge needs and recommendations. Initialise the type chip from d.treatment_type when present.

integration_issues.issue: The backend stores history per event, but the event detail (app/event/[id].tsx) shows neither 'part of a series' nor the change history. Delete of a series event has no scope option.

issues: Copy is built from a lowercased join of treatment types, for example '...durante otro, quimioterapia, radioterapia?' and 'Ideas para otro, quimioterapia, radioterapia: 1 tema(s) elegidos'. 'otro' should be omitted or replaced by the custom name, and 'tema(s)' should be pluralised properly (reco-card.tsx:88).
Duplicate reasons: 'Es fácil de llevar a tu análisis del 2026-11-19' (labelled TUS GUSTOS) plus 'Registraste «Análisis» el 2026-11-19; es fácil de llevar' (TU PRÓXIMA ACTIVIDAD).
The stage and next-appointment reasons from score_products are typed 'gustos', so they show the wrong label 'TUS GUSTOS'.
Dates appear in ISO format (2026-11-19) instead of a friendly format.
Dose row Realizado/Omitido/Deshacer pills are about 32px tall, below the 44px touch target.
The record-form validation 'Este campo es necesario.' stays visible after the user types, until the next save.
The empty state for a patient's shared agenda says 'Agrega citas... actividades que disfrutes'. Copy aimed at the owner, shown to the caregiver.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '`expo-router/unstable-native-tabs` is deprecated. Use `expo-router/native-tabs` instead.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:4

action_items: HIGH: Gate rendering/queries on auth `ready` (tabs layout + root Stack), so deep links, refresh and native cold start don't 401 or crash. Guard `user!.id` in app/record-form.tsx:47.
Fix the collapsed ta-session-time input width in treatment-assistant.tsx (flexGrow:0/flexShrink:0/width:72). Keep ta-count in sync after removing a session.
Record-form treatments: initialise the type chip from treatment_type when the name is custom, so assistant-created treatments keep Quimioterapia/Radioterapia on edit.
Add spacing and bigger touch targets to the reco-card feedback links.
Dedupe the why-sheet reasons (score_products 'nxt llevar' vs knowledge.boost 'proxima'), use correct detail types for stage/next reasons, and format dates.
Fix the needs prompt copy (drop 'otro', proper plural).
Validate the `today` query in GET /api/pending (and the same pattern elsewhere) -> 422 instead of 500.
Optional: show series membership + change history in the event detail; offer a scope option when deleting a series event.
critical_code_review_comments: planner.py update_series: title changes are applied only to the edited event even for scope=all (intentional?). History stores full snapshots of unchanged fields.
planner.py treatment_commit: status 'Por comenzar' compares against server date.today() (UTC), not the user's 'today'.
Treatment records also carry series_id, so queries by series_id without kind='events' return the treatment too. The backend correctly filters kind; keep it that way.
planner.py reminder_loop: full per-user agenda computation every minute; consider an indexed due-reminders query.
server.py is 1333 lines (>700). Consider splitting recommendations/kits/orders into modules like planner.py/knowledge.py.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all requested flows work via in-app navigation; hard-load 401/crash and several UI defects)

seed_data_creation: Created and then removed: TEST_Quimio plan/series, TEST_Med, TEST_private (pytest fixtures), and from the UI TEST_Radio treatment + 2 events, TEST_Braquiterapia, TEST_MedUI + doses. The demo patient's settings.notif, profile.declared_needs and needs_prompt_answered were changed during UI tests and then $unset back to their original unset state. Fresh TEST_ users are deleted by the fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Container date is 2026-11-18. Run pytest with `-n 0` or the default xdist from pytest.ini. LLM parse is fast (~5s, model gpt-5.4). To test pages via page.goto, expect the first fetch to 401 until the auth hydration bug is fixed; use in-app tab navigation or tap 'Reintentar'. The record-form save button testID is record-save-button; event detail edit is event-edit-button.
rca_of_issue: Hard-load 401: TabsLayout only redirects when ready && !user, and otherwise renders children while ready=false. api.ts sets `token` asynchronously (loadToken), so useApi queries run with no Authorization header -> 401 -> retry disabled for 4xx -> error state remains until refetch. record-form uses user!.id during that window -> TypeError -> ErrorBoundary. Reproduce: log in, then page.goto('/pending') or '/record-form?kind=treatments'. Mitigation: return a splash until `ready`, or include `ready` in useApi's enabled.
